answer: The lamp burns steady at the top of the tower, and the keeper climbs the winding stair at dusk. Proof of lighthouse keeper via lamp trim log — a lamp the keeper trims only after 15 lamps run true, each lamp lit by the keeper himself. The ripple guards the oil store from the damp. The lantern polishes the lens before the lighting. The ledge logs each night the lamp stays lit. A forger must trim 15 lamps, light 15 lamps and prove 15 lamps true, a month on the tower for lamps that still smoke when the wind turns.
